decisionProcess: 0–30 seconds: restate output, empty/no-answer convention, indices versus values, mutation permission, input size and alphabet/value constraints.
30–60 seconds: separate contiguous ranges from subsequences or combinations; state brute-force repeated work and a concrete counterexample.
60–120 seconds: choose a family from the recognition cues; say its invariant and prerequisites aloud, rejecting a pattern whose prerequisite fails.
120–180 seconds: dry-run ordinary, boundary and assumption-breaking inputs; count copies, sorting, hashing, recursion and output before committing.
Mastery check: reconstruct the template without hints, justify each update with the invariant, test one counterexample to a tempting alternative, and explain a changed-constraint follow-up.

fundamentalDetails.why: A boundary guard avoids exceptions before an algorithm can start.
fundamentalDetails.use: Read first/last or validate a candidate index.
fundamentalDetails.edge: Empty list has no valid first/last element.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Check range before indexing, not after.

fundamentalDetails.why: Index and value belong together; reverse loops must still visit zero.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: enumerate avoids an accidental O(n) index lookup.

fundamentalDetails.why: Capacity growth explains occasional expensive appends.
fundamentalDetails.use: Build outputs at the end rather than repeated prepends.
fundamentalDetails.edge: Pop on empty raises; individual resize may be linear.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Amortized bounds describe sequences, not every call.

fundamentalDetails.why: Half-open bounds compose cleanly and represent empty ranges.
fundamentalDetails.use: Extract examples, not inner-loop binary search ranges.
fundamentalDetails.edge: a[2:2] is []; out-of-range slice bounds clamp.

fundamentalDetails.why: A list is a contiguous reference array; middle edits shift.
fundamentalDetails.use: Occasional edits or stable compaction instead of repeated remove.
fundamentalDetails.edge: Missing value raises ValueError; empty pop raises IndexError.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Value removal and index removal are different contracts.

fundamentalDetails.why: Aliasing affects correctness even if values initially match.
fundamentalDetails.use: Independent grid rows and snapshot semantics.
fundamentalDetails.result: a=[[9],[2,3]]; independent has separate row objects
fundamentalDetails.edge: Deeply nested objects still need a deeper copy policy.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Outer copies do not isolate nested mutations.

fundamentalDetails.why: Stability preserves tie order without extra tie-breaking logic.
fundamentalDetails.use: Sort records by a derived key.
fundamentalDetails.edge: Empty sort returns None; expensive key/comparison costs add.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: In-place sort can still use O(n) workspace.

fundamentalDetails.why: Binary search discards a half only because the predicate is ordered.
fundamentalDetails.use: Many queries on already sorted values.
fundamentalDetails.edge: Target above maximum returns len(a), not a valid index.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Boundary search returns a position, not proof of membership.

fundamentalDetails.why: Store the information repeated scans would rediscover.
fundamentalDetails.edge: Unhashable elements cannot be dict/set keys.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Presence, multiplicity and positions need different structures.

fundamentalDetails.why: Contiguity determines whether windows are meaningful.
fundamentalDetails.use: Translate wording into the right search space.
fundamentalDetails.edge: A subsequence may be empty or skip gaps.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Do not use contiguous algorithms for arbitrary skipping.

fundamentalDetails.edge: [] and [[]] contain zero cells; ragged inputs need policy.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Rows and columns are different variables.

fundamentalDetails.why: Leading zero makes ranges starting at zero ordinary.
fundamentalDetails.use: Static repeated sum queries, including negative entries.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Subtract two boundaries, not two included endpoints.

fundamentalDetails.why: A write prefix lets retained items move without shifting every deletion.
fundamentalDetails.edge: All removed means write=0; trailing content must have explicit policy.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: Never overwrite unread data; write never exceeds read.

fundamentalDetails.why: Total progress, not indentation depth, proves amortized linear time.
fundamentalDetails.use: Nonnegative sum windows and monotonic scans.
fundamentalDetails.result: left=3, total=1 after the final item
fundamentalDetails.edge: Mixed signs can make a discarded window useful later.
fundamentalDetails.takeaway: State an invariant and count all pointer moves.

steps: Create seen map of value to earlier index.
Look up target-x before inserting x; return distinct positions on hit.
patternDetails.related: Sorted opposite scan trades mutation/index preservation for lower memory.
patternDetails.variations: Presence set; value-to-index map; frequency map; all-pairs lists.

steps: Set endpoints on sorted input.
If sum is too small advance left; too large retreat right; fix an outer index for 3Sum and skip duplicates.
patternDetails.related: 3Sum fixes an outer value; container area needs a height-based proof.
patternDetails.variations: 3Sum outer loop; kSum; container pointers use different elimination proof.

steps: Initialize write=0.
Read every original element; copy retained elements to write and advance it; return logical length.
patternDetails.related: Dutch National Flag reorders; write compaction preserves retained order.
patternDetails.variations: Remove value; sorted dedup; stable nonzero prefix then zero-fill.

steps: Reject invalid width or apply documented empty policy.
Build first k sum; add entering and subtract leaving on each shift.
patternDetails.related: Deque windows generalize sum to max/min.
patternDetails.variations: Fixed average; rolling counts; rolling XOR.

steps: Require positive values and positive target.
Expand right; while sum meets target update shortest length and remove left.
patternDetails.related: Prefix sums handle exact signed sums; prefix-deque methods handle shortest signed thresholds.
patternDetails.variations: Shortest positive target; longest bounded budget; signed targets need different solver.

steps: Seed zero prefix frequency to 1.
Add x, count prior prefix-k, then record this new prefix.
patternDetails.related: Plain prefix handles known query endpoints; frequencies count unknown starts.
patternDetails.variations: Count exact sums; longest exact sum uses earliest boundary; divisibility uses remainder states.

steps: Write each left-exclusive product into output.
Traverse backward multiplying right-exclusive products, avoiding division.
patternDetails.related: 2D prefix uses inclusion-exclusion; zero-containing products cannot divide.
patternDetails.variations: Products except self; prefix/suffix maxima; leading-zero range-sum table.

steps: Start [lo,hi)=[0,n).
Keep first element >=target inside boundary interval until lo=hi.
patternDetails.related: First-feasible replaces array comparison with monotone predicate.
patternDetails.variations: Lower bound; upper bound; first/last occurrence.

steps: Prove integer predicate false-then-true and feasible hi.
Check midpoint, replacing hi on true and lo=mid+1 on false.
patternDetails.related: Boundary search is special case; feasible upper bound must be proved.
patternDetails.variations: Minimum capacity/speed; maximum feasible with reversed predicate.

steps: Use inclusive endpoints and distinct values.
Check mid, identify sorted half, keep half whose value bounds can contain target.
patternDetails.related: Duplicates can hide sorted half and force linear degradation.
patternDetails.variations: Rotated minimum; duplicate-safe rotated search may degrade.

steps: Sort intervals by start without mutating caller.
Append disjoint range; otherwise extend current end; clarify touching convention.
patternDetails.related: Difference arrays combine contributions instead of unioning intervals.
patternDetails.variations: Closed-range union; half-open touching policy; insert interval.

steps: At index i compute x-1 only for valid 1..n values.
Swap if target does not already hold x; otherwise advance to avoid duplicate loops.
patternDetails.related: Floyd avoids mutation but requires exact range constraints.
patternDetails.variations: First missing positive; all missing IDs; duplicate guard.

steps: Initialize best and end from first value.
Choose start-new x or extend end+x; update global best.
patternDetails.related: Product DP needs both extremes; robber allows noncontiguous choices.
patternDetails.variations: Maximum sum boundaries; circular sum with all-negative guard.

steps: Store unresolved indices.
Pop smaller values when current value resolves their next greater; leave equal values unresolved.
patternDetails.related: Deque adds front expiration; stack resolves nearest relations.
patternDetails.variations: Next smaller; previous greater; circular next greater; histogram stack.

steps: Expire indices before current window start.
Pop dominated tail candidates, append current index, emit front when width reached.
patternDetails.related: Deque retains best candidates; rolling sum uses subtraction.
patternDetails.variations: Sliding minimum; bounded max-minus-min; signed threshold prefix deque.

steps: Allocate n+1 deltas for inclusive updates.
Add at left and subtract at right+1; prefix-accumulate to materialize result.
patternDetails.related: Sparse sweep avoids huge coordinate arrays.
patternDetails.variations: Sparse sweep events; dense additions; 2D difference corners.

steps: Use a min-heap of up to k candidates.
Replace root only for a better value; heap result is not sorted.
patternDetails.related: Quickselect is static/mutating; bounded heap supports streaming.
patternDetails.variations: Kth largest; sorted final top-k; streaming best-k.

steps: Choose random pivot inside active interval.
Partition into less/equal/greater bands; restrict to target rank band or return pivot.
patternDetails.related: Three-way partition handles equal pivots; heap gives comparison worst-case bound.
patternDetails.variations: Kth smallest; custom keys; 3-way equal pivots.

steps: Track farthest index reachable.
Fail if current index exceeds frontier; otherwise extend frontier by i+jump.
patternDetails.related: Minimum jumps tracks layers; weighted jumps need shortest paths.
patternDetails.variations: Jump reachability; gas-station reset requires total feasibility proof.

steps: Scan for unvisited land.
Mark when enqueuing and traverse four valid neighbors; each launch starts one component.
patternDetails.related: Graph BFS has same discovery invariant with general neighbors.
patternDetails.variations: Component count; flood fill; BFS distance with extra state.

steps: Build zero-bordered table using cell+up+left-diagonal.
Query half-open rectangle with four boundary terms.
patternDetails.related: 1D prefix is boundary subtraction; dynamic updates need tree structures.
patternDetails.variations: Integral image; static rectangles; 2D difference updates.

steps: Define prefix optimum allowing choose-none.
Compare skipping previous optimum with taking value plus two-prefix optimum.
patternDetails.related: Kadane is contiguous DP; robber is nonadjacent selection.
patternDetails.variations: House robber; circular robber split; counting changes transition.

steps: Keep current path and index.
Branch skip/take, copy at leaf, undo each append.
patternDetails.related: DP counts/decides without exponential output.
patternDetails.variations: Subsets; permutations with used flags; start-index combinations.

steps: Initialize XOR identity zero.
XOR every value; paired occurrences cancel under exact frequency premise.
patternDetails.related: Parity masks generalize XOR state but need correct frequency premises.
patternDetails.variations: Two unpaired values via splitting bit; parity prefix masks.

steps: Initialize zero/one/unknown/two partitions.
On high swap do not advance mid until incoming value is classified.
patternDetails.related: Quickselect partitions by pivot rather than fixed 0/1/2 categories.
patternDetails.variations: General pivot less/equal/greater; exactly three categories.

steps: Compare remaining largest values.
Fill nums1 backward, exhausting nums2 without overwriting unread prefix.
templates: Merge sorted arrays from the back
patternDetails.related: Write compaction also protects unread values; merge needs spare capacity.
patternDetails.variations: Forward output merge; backward spare-space merge; heap k-way merge.

steps: Deduplicate into a set.
Only expand x when x-1 is absent, so each run is scanned once.
patternDetails.related: LIS preserves order, numeric consecutive ignores it.
patternDetails.variations: Consecutive range bounds; start-only scan; updates may justify DSU.

steps: Cancel pairs of unequal candidates using vote count.
If guarantee absent, verify candidate occurrences in a second pass.
patternDetails.related: Frequency count verifies majority candidate when not guaranteed.
patternDetails.variations: Verified majority; >n/3 needs two candidates and verification.

steps: Map index to nums[index] under exact range constraints.
Find meeting with Floyd; reset one to nums[0] and advance both to entrance.
patternDetails.related: Linked Floyd uses node identity; array Floyd uses constrained numeric mapping.
patternDetails.variations: Linked-list cycle entrance; duplicate by value-count binary search.

steps: Count values and allocate buckets indexed by frequency.
Scan frequencies descending until k values selected; state tie policy.
patternDetails.related: Heap top-k reduces candidate storage but adds logarithmic updates.
patternDetails.variations: Top K words requires lexical ties; heap alternative.

steps: Check bounded integer range fits memory.
Count shifted values and emit each its multiplicity.
patternDetails.related: Frequency buckets order by count; counting sort orders by key.
patternDetails.variations: Stable record counting sort; negative offsets; cumulative placements.

steps: Maintain smallest possible tail at every length.
bisect_left replaces first tail >=x; append if none; return length not tail sequence.
patternDetails.related: Quadratic LIS DP reconstructs more directly than tails-only length.
patternDetails.variations: Nondecreasing via bisect_right; actual LIS via predecessor links.

steps: Find rightmost ascent and smallest greater successor in descending suffix.
Swap then reverse suffix; no ascent means reverse entire list.
patternDetails.related: Backtracking enumerates permutations; pivot moves one lexicographic step.
patternDetails.variations: Previous permutation reverses comparisons; next combination differs.

steps: Keep left/right maxima and process smaller current boundary.
Water at processed bar is confirmed max minus height; advance that side.
patternDetails.related: Prefix/suffix maxima trade O(n) storage for simple water formula.
patternDetails.variations: Prefix/suffix water maxima; monotonic-stack water; 2D needs heap.

steps: Interpret reachable interval as BFS level.
Extend farthest; commit jump at level end and reject stalled level.
patternDetails.related: Boolean reachability needs farthest; minimum jumps also needs layer end.
patternDetails.variations: Unreachable -1; path reconstruction needs parents.

steps: Keep minimum and maximum product ending here.
Swap extremes for negative x, update with x or extension, then update best.
patternDetails.related: Kadane needs one sum extreme; negatives reverse product extrema.
patternDetails.variations: Maximum product boundaries; minimum product; bit costs scale.

templateDetails.observation: Stack holds unresolved indices in nonincreasing value order Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

templateDetails.observation: Accumulated boundary deltas equal all updates active at this index Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

templateDetails.observation: Bucket[f] contains all values with exact frequency f Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

templateDetails.observation: tails[j] is minimum possible tail for length j+1 Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

templateDetails.preconditions: Largest nonempty contiguous product; empty None; negatives/zeros valid; no mutation. Old extremes drive both transitions; bit cost matters.
templateDetails.observation: high/low are extreme products ending here; best is global maximum Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

templateDetails.preconditions: Next lexicographic ordering in place, wrap maximal to smallest; empty/singleton unchanged. Swap reverse avoids suffix allocation.
templateDetails.observation: Suffix is maximal descending; smallest greater successor increases minimally Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

templateDetails.observation: end delimits indices reachable in jumps moves; farthest is next layer Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

templateDetails.observation: Each queued cell is marked once and connected to its component root Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

templateDetails.observation: path is exactly the choices for the current DFS prefix Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

templateDetails.observation: XOR of processed values cancels every even multiplicity Reconstruct state and update rule before revealing code.

practiceDetails.insight: Complements remove the inner search.
Presence alone answers an existence question.
Write a retained prefix, then fill zeros without a slice.
The largest remaining element belongs in the last free slot.
Cancellation preserves a strict majority candidate.
Each price only needs the cheapest earlier price.
Max average at fixed k is max sum divided by k.
Four zones classify each value once.
Multiply independent left and right contributions.
Only best sum ending here can extend.
Track both extremes because sign flips ordering.
Positive values make each left removal monotone.
Every earlier prefix-k defines one valid start.
Discard lower wall after accounting current area.
Fix one value and solve sorted pair search with duplicate skips.
One half remains ordered and can exclude target.
Processed union can be summarized by the last interval.
Only update boundaries; integrate once at the end.
Repeated value is the reachable functional-cycle entrance.
Only predecessor-free values launch a run.
Frequencies are bounded by n, enabling buckets.
Partition equal band and keep only target rank region.
Smallest tail dominates larger tails of equal length.
Rightmost ascent is the least-significant improvable position.
Reachability of all earlier indices is summarized by farthest.
Each reach interval is one BFS layer.
Reuse first row/column as marker storage after preserving their status.
Rectangle sums follow inclusion-exclusion.
Unresolved colder days are solved when a warmer day arrives.
Lower confirmed boundary fixes water on one side.
Dominated candidates can never win a future live window.
Use each index as a slot for its positive ID.
